// FORM 2 OF 3: ReceiveAsync into a concrete struct. This is the form
// billing/closecycle.go:192 and :217 use — legitimately there, because neither
// inboundRevenueReceived nor chargebackReceived has a bus producer — and the form
// operations/delinquencyenforcement.go would have used had Task 1 not changed it.
//
// A gate that matched only the blocking Receive would ship as coverage it has not.
package badreceiveasync

const signalApplyDelinquencyPolicy = "applyDelinquencyPolicy"

type applyDelinquencySignal struct {
	CustomerID string
	Action     int
}

func BadReceiveAsync(ctx workflow.Context) bool {
	ch := workflow.GetSignalChannel(ctx, signalApplyDelinquencyPolicy)
	var ev applyDelinquencySignal
	if !ch.ReceiveAsync(&ev) { // WANT: flagged — concrete struct target on a bus-delivered name
		return false
	}
	return ev.CustomerID != ""
}
